scripts.validate:sprint-tasks: uv run --frozen python -m workbench sprint validate
scripts.validate:pipeline: uv run --frozen python -m workbench pipeline validate
scripts.validate:ado: uv run --frozen python -m workbench ado resolve --validate
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:sprint-tasks && npm run validate:pipeline && npm run validate:ado
scripts.sync:claude: uv run --frozen python -m workbench sync claude
scripts.sync:codex: uv run --frozen python -m workbench sync codex
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check src tests
scripts.format: uv run ruff format src tests
